thread:
amy: Heads-up: proposing a small-surface "egress-optin" for Private installs. Purpose: let customers opt to serve egress while retaining safe control-plane fallbacks. low-risk beta.
derek: Sounds good. what are the minimum UX and installer changes?
amy: Installer flag --egress=relay|tenant, plus a k8s annotation for opt-in. default stays relay. beta gates: health probes + auto-fallback after 4 consecutive failures.
sofia: Field requirement: customers want a grace window to preserve client IPs for 60m after upgrades. add pin_egress_minutes config.
nate: Security: must enforce mTLS and cert pinning. runtime should emit a stable runtime_id (sealed by KMS) so we can map logs when IPs change.
derek: Tests: 1) partition -> fallback; 2) NAT rotation -> runtime_id preserved; 3) no sensitive keys in logs. Need telemetry: fallback_count, pin_window_expiry.
infra-bot: Tasks created: PVT-5001 (installer flag), PVT-5002 (fallback probe), PVT-5003 (runtime_id sealed), Owners: @amy PVT-5001, @derek PVT-5002.
amy: Timeline proposal: alpha with 2 Dedicated customers in Q2, wider private beta in Q3. Keep config tiny to allow fast patches. reconvene Wed 11?
derek: Wed 11 ok. I'll draft the minimal install change and tests.
